user.title: Connect to CEZ Distribuce PND
user.description: Enter your credentials for the CEZ Distribuce Measured Data Portal (PND) and your meter identifiers.

data.debug_mode: Log safe diagnostics during initial connection
data.tariff_entity: Optional VT/NT Tariff boolean entity (e.g. binary_sensor.hdo)

identity_warning.title: Cannot verify the EAN in the PND export
identity_warning.description: The portal accepted the login and returned a CSV for its only device set, but neither the dashboard nor the CSV proves that the data belongs to the EAN and ELM you entered. If your account has multiple EANs, values could be assigned to the wrong Home Assistant statistics. Check the EAN, ELM and meter relationship in the PND portal. Continue only if you accept this risk; otherwise cancel and share the safe diagnostic log in issue #2.

data.confirm_unverified_identity: I checked the meter relationship and accept that PND does not verify this EAN in the export

reconfigure.description: Update credentials and meter settings for EAN {ean}.

init.description: Update synchronization parameters and tariff settings. Enabling cost tracking reveals the price fields; selecting an HDO entity switches between one price and high/low tariff prices.

costs.title: Energy price settings
costs.description: Set the price and effective date. Without an HDO entity, one price applies to all consumption. To distinguish high and low tariffs, select an HDO entity in the previous step. Conflicting older prices requiring correction: {conflict_dates}.
